meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会当协调人,让每个 git 工作树/分支/PR 的“代理”在共享聊天里轮流发言,比对改动、解决冲突,最后产出一份合并计划(目标工作树+合并顺序+冲突处理),并用通俗语言向你汇报。只做决策,不实际合并。
howto.when: 当你要求对比或合并多个工作树、分支或 PR 的改动,或提到“standup”时触发。

say.text: 对比最近 24 小时活跃的工作树,给我一个合并方案。
say.note: 会按时间窗口召集代理开会并产出计划。

say.text: 让这几个分支和 PR 开个站会,讨论如何整合。
say.note: 为指定分支/PR 创建房间并按轮次讨论。

say.text: 对 main 之外的工作树做个 standup,列出合并顺序。
say.note: 会生成待办清单和需要你拍板的决策。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as facilitator: each worktree/branch/PR gets an agent that chats in a shared file, compares changes, resolves conflicts, and produces one consolidation plan (target + merge order + resolutions), then summarizes plainly. Read-only, no merging.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to compare or consolidate changes across multiple worktrees, branches, or PRs, or mention "standup".

say_en.text: Compare worktrees active in the last 24h and give me a merge plan.
say_en.note: Runs the standup and returns a consolidation plan.

say_en.text: Hold a standup for these branches and PRs to discuss how to integrate them.
say_en.note: Creates a room and runs rounds for the selected branches/PRs.

say_en.text: Run a standup on worktrees other than main and list the merge order.
say_en.note: Produces the target and order plus decisions for you.
